name: BATCMP.jcl
description:
This JCL job compiles a COBOL batch program named BATCHPGM using a standardized build procedure (BUILDBAT) defined in the utility procedure library. It automates the compilation process by referencing a shared procedure library under the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO environment, producing a compiled batch executable ready for deployment.Key Functionalities:
Compiles the COBOL batch program identified as BATCHPGM using the BUILDBAT procedure from the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO utility procedure library
Utilizes parameterized settings (member name and high-level qualifier) to allow flexible and reusable compilation across different program members
Produces a compiled batch program output suitable for execution in the CardDemo application environment
